sources.title: Otiluke's Conveniently Portable Freezing Sphere
markers: | description = Create a vessel for {{SAI|Otiluke's Freezing Sphere (Launch)|Otiluke's Freezing Sphere}}. Put it in your pocket, give it to an ally, or throw it away. It will explode after 10 turn(s).

sources.title: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere (Launch)
markers: | description = Launch a ball of churning ice that explodes and damages all creatures and objects within range.

sources.title: Explosion Imminent!
markers: | effects = * The freezing sphere will explode, casting {{SAI|Otiluke's Freezing Sphere (Launch)|Otiluke's Freezing Sphere}}.

summary: A spell-created portable grenade. Throw it or let its ten-turn timer expire to unleash Freezing Sphere.

fields.Blast: Throw as an Action, 60 ft range. Creatures and objects in a 20 ft radius take 10d6 Cold, half on a Constitution save. Creates an Ice surface for 10 turns. The launch is usable while Silenced. If still intact after 10 turns, the orb explodes automatically.
fields.Creation: Cast the level-6 portable spell as an Action on an ally in melee range. Pass, drop or throw the orb before Explosion Imminent expires after 10 turns. A target with no inventory, such as a summon, cannot drop or throw it.
fields.Base value: 0 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Object defenses: Resists Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant. Vulnerable to Bludgeoning and Fire. Immune to Poison and Psychic.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
